scope: Declaration inventory only: web-app ui-* roster, standard preset top-level plugins, standard delegation children, and Android disabled entries. This is not an exhaustive inventory of all DSH behaviors, optional bundles, CLI surfaces, or nested non-delegation groups.
evidencePolicy: Each evidence level is a manual, scoped claim. partial records known overlap without certifying equivalence; unverified is explicit. Portable tools, native references, recorded skill rows and workspace changes and filesystem tools cite executed host composition or behavior checks, not device acceptance for their new controls. Existing device observations remain narrowly described. File existence never upgrades evidence; inventory validation is not feature completion.

entries.note: Android ACTION_VIEW offers an external app for supported, authorized files with cancellable staging and FileProvider access. Desktop file reveal/association behavior differs, and device launch and provider handling remain unverified.

Native account reads and sign-in exist. The explicit authorization-link fallback carries the active palette and preserves Host query parameters; account balances follow original two-decimal and sub-cent display rules without changing raw values. Full original settings, onboarding, quota notice, profile-image lifecycle and device behavior have not been established.
Native theme preferences and FlClash surfaces implement the requested mobile presentation; original preference equivalence remains unverified.

Native external-keyboard handling covers original new-session Ctrl+N, conversation-search Ctrl+K, sidebar toggle Ctrl+B, settings Ctrl+Comma, composer focus and contextual Escape. Focused Flutter tests pass; the remaining original shortcut roster and physical keyboard behavior remain unverified.
Native floating shell exists; the original complete layout/navigation surface remains to be checked.
Flutter renders mapped surfaces, but arbitrary original client-plugin slot registrations do not automatically become native UI.
Native session observations exist; full original paging and all projections require feature-level review.
Native workspace and conversation navigation exists; per-action parity and restoration remain separately verified.

A per-session mobile resource page links real files, saved changes, skill catalog, tasks, process-backed terminals and a separate remote browser. Focused Flutter tests cover navigation without starting Agent work. Original docked-tab composition and terminal/browser device behavior remain unverified.

Original reader bundles run in a Session-bound document-only surface with host rendering and original Gateway evidence. Same-Session links, line navigation, source-position restoration and rejected cross-Session links have host coverage. Build 32 displayed synthetic text; Build 33 displayed Markdown, followed same-Session links to text line 220 and returned at the source position. The original Office provider converted a synthetic DOCX through authorized Session reads, the Android-profile Gateway and bounded PDF byte transfer on the host; Android runs the pinned kit in a child process so its WASM heap is released on exit. This does not reduce conversion-time device memory pressure. Android WebView rendering and device memory behavior remain unverified. Interactive HTML preferences are still a gap.

Session resources offer remote HTTP(S) address entry and page-local launch history. AndroidX Custom Tabs owns network loading, navigation and cookies, keeping untrusted pages outside the App WebView/document bridge; direct local/private-address input is rejected. A remote redirect can still contact a local service, whose protection is server-side authentication and origin checks. The original embedded/docked browser is not migrated. Custom Tabs launch and lifecycle have host compile evidence only, no device acceptance.

The mobile Session resource page opens process-backed terminals and projects bounded xterm cells with ANSI/RGB colors, emphasis, inverse video and cursor position. Host runtime and Flutter tests cover projection, alternate buffers, text copy and reconnect ownership. Program OSC palette changes, cursor visibility and shape persist with the PTY across page re-entry. Complete VT/OSC query semantics, per-key IME input and desktop dock behavior remain absent; device execution and process-tree cleanup remain unverified.

Current Session files use the original cold Session cwd and workspaceFiles list/change feed. Native same-page navigation and original-service host smoke pass. Build 32 listed the test Session cwd and opened its existing text file on the phone; nested device navigation and remaining file interactions are unverified.

Native structured configuration pages exist. Restoring a user override previews the descriptor's inherited value without writing it; focused form tests cover switches and finite choices. Workspace-change visibility and reads use the original ui-settings/enabled value with no App-only default. Schema accessibility does not establish complete settings workflow parity.

General Settings reads and writes the original revisioned ui-settings.enabled preference through a native switch. The shared value gates Session trajectory visibility and built-in uncustomized PTC/Minimal preset choices as well as workspace-change presentation; it is not a tool permission. Disabling conditionally changes an uncustomized built-in PTC/Minimal default to a healthy Standard preset through the original revisioned settings service; customized, unknown or changed defaults require manual review. Contributed General rows, onboarding and device acceptance remain incomplete.

Native provider/model/credential forms call shared services. A catalog outage retains provider settings and the saved default but blocks model changes until a bounded or manual retry succeeds; widget tests cover this separation. Full original action and device recovery coverage is not certified here.
Native shared package operations exist; device install, lifecycle scripts, and third-party compatibility remain unverified.

Native Host snapshot inventory shows preset-first entries, optional global entries, full entry and module identities, conditional disablement, runtime phase, discovery failures and preset-provider relationships in read-only detail. Focused widget tests cover these projections; device behavior and remaining original presentation interactions are unverified.
Native composer and transcript exist; resource actions, all context projections and view switching remain incomplete.

Native decisions, plan-review actions, recommended question options and original answer labels have focused tests. A private write-ahead marker persists possible reply submission across Host restarts and blocks duplicate delivery for identified requests; a started marker does not prove delivery and may leave an unanswered request blocked until authoritative reconciliation exists. Full request-variant comparison and device behavior remain incomplete.

Native transcript renders authored text, Markdown, tool rows, recorded skill and Session reference chips, delivered files and original workspace-change summaries. Settled local Markdown images now load inline through the original Session-scoped workspaceFiles stat/readBytes service with bounded bytes and version checks, then open the native zoom viewer; failures can retry or open the original file. Confirmed skill names and Session labels come from the original log, not the current catalog. Remote Markdown images remain explicit external links rather than inline fetches, and file-image hover cards, all other original actions and phone acceptance remain incomplete.
The user-requested Pocket Harness branding replaces the original visible brand in native UI.
Original attachment receipts are used with Android picking and historical reads; all media/limit/recovery device paths remain open.
Native paired tool records and details exist; generic fallback does not implement every original keyed tool presentation.
Only generic tool details are available; original Cordis-specific editing and workflow presentation are not fully migrated.

Native present cards fold original persisted events by completed turn, preserve exact file paths and open the Session reader. Changed-file cards and native diffs use the original announcement coordinates and summary/diff service, gated by shared ui-settings/enabled. Captured bytes do not survive a service restart; outside Git, file-operation capture excludes arbitrary Shell changes. Original-profile host smoke and widget tests cover read-only behavior, cancellation, cold unavailable results and shared preference changes; device acceptance remains unverified.
Shared workspace/session registry operations exist; all original lifecycle actions remain subject to individual acceptance.

Existing Session workflow run/start/end and member events replay into a read-only run/stage/member view, including pagination and interruption semantics. Host-tested navigation from a historical run to a still-running child Session revalidates parent ownership and connection generation. Android still cannot create runs because PTC/workflow execution is disabled; device behavior remains unverified.

Inline slash command candidates and file/Session at-reference selection now use the original catalog with cancellation, drill-down and same-token dismissal behavior under host tests. Full keyboard candidate navigation, all original source arbitration and device behavior remain unverified.
Runtime command catalog and dispatch are reused; command-specific status and result surfaces need individual parity review.

Native slash suggestions and a searchable picker use original skills/list, preserve user-only skills, insert literal /name text and keep command precedence. Recorded injection batches confirm sent skill chips; dedicated skill rows use original call/result data and open recorded instructions, while reference previews open the current provider file. Host replay and widget checks cover these distinctions. Build 33 displayed a synthetic user-only skill and opened its provider file on the phone; composer invocation and the new historical chips/rows still need device acceptance.
Native child tree/history and control exist; at-reference source and full original observations remain incomplete.

Native @ discovery calls the original fileReferences and sessionReferenceResolver services, retains exact path/canonical Session mentions, and separates folder selection from descent. Owner-bound cancellation and query/connection invalidation reject late results. Sent references follow original UTF-16 and recorded-label rules; file chips open the source Session reader, while folder/Session chips remain labels. Real Android-profile host discovery and focused widgets pass; phone acceptance is unverified.

The App stages the original pure matcher and applies its UTF-16 ranges before other references in sent user text. Host matcher and Flutter rendering tests pass; Android device display and every original formatter combination remain unverified.

Shared job record streaming and stop requests exist. An Android-private type/time receipt makes a lost runtime visible on the task page after restart without claiming a task result or replaying work; focused host tests cover record redaction and display. Complete original output/terminal behavior and device notification delivery remain unverified.
Shared schedule listing/edit/delete and delivery records exist; complete original lifecycle/device acceptance remains open.

Native goal creation with an optional round cap, current-goal presentation, edit, pause, resume and clear use the original goal service and sequenced Session projection. Host lifecycle, stale-revision and process-local activation transitions have focused Flutter tests. Complete original behavior and device interaction remain unverified.

Native reply actions include feedback state and like/dislike submission through the original service; host projection and widget tests pass. Device behavior and complete original feedback semantics remain unverified.
Native model selection and original projections exist; the ledger does not certify every original action or concurrent edit path.

Native Session and home model labels use the original exact provider, model ID and catalog-name predicate for the presentation-only 1017 badge. The current Loader inventory must confirm the plugin is enabled and active; absent, failed and unconfirmed states omit the badge. Host and widget tests cover the projection; device presentation remains unverified.

Desktop permission presets remain disabled. Android now shows a runtime-observed read-only execution policy and per-call approval, but cannot offer equivalent sandbox choices until Shell confinement exists.
Native preset selection exists, but only the Android preset is supported; original preset capabilities remain incomplete.

When the Host serves session-log-deepseek, General Settings displays its accepted enabled value as a native switch and saves once with the original document revision. Read-only, absent, non-boolean and uncertain states do not issue a write; a fresh read and explicit review are required after an uncertain result. Focused Host-mirror tests cover this App control, but request upload behavior and device acceptance remain unverified.
Plugin settings schemas are accessible, but full original semantic controls and contributed UI are not implied.
Native Android Shell settings exist; desktop Bash/PowerShell/sandbox settings require explicit platform adaptation.
Loop settings are exposed through native forms; original semantic workflow parity is unverified.
Native child-model selection and parameters exist; complete original settings coverage remains unverified.
Native shared search-provider/credential workflow exists; every provider path still requires original behavior comparison.

Native plan mode, submitted-plan cards and reading flow are wired to original records and interactions; focused Flutter tests cover their transitions. Device behavior and complete original planning semantics remain unverified.
Native form and notification answers use original requests; all original question variants and lifecycle paths remain to be accepted.

Native read-only session trajectory includes a timeline, request and tool-result correlation, record inspector, recorded token totals, Session-authorized attachment gallery and stream timing from recorded chunks. Original PTC nesting, interval zoom/pan and Android device acceptance remain outstanding.
Android persona describes the actual app UID, Shell and SAF capabilities; exact desktop persona is intentionally not claimed.

The exact original preset entry is staged. The real Android-profile host smoke exercised baseline, nested discovery, replacement, removal and cold reconciliation without rewriting prior events; device behavior remains unverified.

The exact original preset entry is staged. The real Android-profile host smoke exercised client time zone admission, invalid-zone rejection, refresh and cold projection; device clock and zone behavior remain unverified.
Android app-UID Shell exists; desktop Bash command capabilities and sandbox behavior are not equivalent.
PowerShell tool is platform-conditional upstream; Android equivalent behavior is not implemented or waived.

Original read/write/edit tools are enabled with the original filesystem sandbox and observed-version policy. Staged Android-profile host checks exercise real filesystem mutations, blind/stale overwrite rejection, unique-match and replace_all edits, workspace/symlink bounds, one-invocation approval outcomes, publication cancellation and cold recovery without replay. SAF remains read-only, image/tool presentation parity is not certified, and Android Binder/device acceptance remains unverified.

The Android Agent preset now registers the original glob/grep tools with the standard result policy and a pinned Android ARM64 ripgrep. A host runtime smoke verifies model-facing tool registration; Android process launch and Agent search remain unverified on device. SAF content URIs require a materialized Session file.

The exact original model-visible jobs tool is staged. The real Android-profile host smoke exercised ownership, cursor, wait timeout, cancellation, durable events and one completion wake; device execution remains unverified.
Original schedule tool is copied from standard; native UI and actual delivery paths require separate acceptance.

Original filesystem skill discovery is staged unchanged. The shipped Android profile discovers a synthetic project skill on the host; native skill selection and device filesystem acceptance remain open.

Original skill invocation is staged unchanged. Host profile checks cover cold catalog reads without Agent activation or log writes and literal user-only invocation. Native discovery uses that directory; recorded call/result rows preserve historical name, output and failure independently of the current catalog. Full invocation and recorded-row device acceptance remain pending.

The original /goal command is staged and exposed in the native composer. Native goal controls use the same goal service, with focused lifecycle and CAS tests; full command-flow and device acceptance remain unverified.

The original model-facing goal tool is staged. Native controls read the same durable goal projection and call the original goal service; focused tests cover cold reads, reconnects, CAS conflicts and process-local activation. Full model-tool behavior and device recovery remain unverified.
Original isolated planning group is copied; native plan artifacts and status controls remain incomplete.
Original compaction group is copied; complete command/status behavior is not certified by inventory checks.
Only four original local subagent tools are copied; workflow-ptc and tool-workflow are omitted.
Original user-question tool is composed with Android timed mode; native/notification lifecycle needs individual coverage.

Original todo_write is staged unchanged. Native history and the floating current list fold durable whole-list updates, preserve concurrent in-progress items and clear on turn/start. Host profile and widget evidence exist; device acceptance is pending.

The Android Agent preset now inherits the original web_search and web_fetch configuration (including fetch and timeout), with model-facing registration checked in a host runtime smoke. Provider responses and Android network behavior still require acceptance.

Original present is staged unchanged. Native completed-turn cards retain declaration coordinates and exact paths and open the same Session document reader. Missing-file rejection and cold restoration have host evidence; device acceptance is pending.

Original desktop permission presets are disabled. The App reads the actual file-tool mode and Shell one-shot approval policy; app UID execution still lacks per-command confinement, so no preset switch is advertised.
Original desktop permission presets are disabled. The native settings page reports the runtime's actual execution boundary and opens pending approvals; it does not claim desktop sandbox parity.

The original controller remains disabled because node-pty has no packaged Android binary. A separate Android PTY backend and basic mobile page provide Session-bound process, bounded screen and command input. Original Client stream control, full VT rendering, retention and device behavior are not migrated or validated.

The desktop plugin stays disabled in the Android runtime; native ACTION_VIEW provides a scoped substitute. Host policy and cancellation checks pass, but desktop reveal semantics and device launch are not equivalent or verified.
Native file and document actions replace the desktop UI plugin through a guarded chooser. Route/background cancellation has host tests; device chooser and all file providers remain unverified.
Original auto picker is replaced by the browse provider plus Android SAF picking; the authorities remain distinct.

The original fs-sandbox loader id is disabled, but android-filesystem mounts the same @deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-sandbox provider with workspace-write defaults. Original file tools retain mutation containment, observed-version checks and one-invocation escalation; host profile smoke exercises these operations and cancellation. This does not add kernel confinement to android_shell or migrate the original permission menu. Device acceptance is unverified.

Original programmatic tool execution remains disabled. Its Node child requires per-run workspace confinement, but sandbox-local has no Android runner. Android code wires one bounded literal edit over an App-selected workspace text snapshot through an isolated Service and revision-checked writeback; host compilation and pure-Java tests pass, but device execution is unverified. This diagnostic file-operation slice is not a Node program backend. General file mapping, tool callbacks, descendant confinement and restart ownership remain open. Startup and plugin-management guards still reject activation.

Original PTC workflow engine remains disabled because no Android runner can execute its Node script under the original per-run confinement contract. Android code provides a diagnostic isolated-worker path for one bounded literal workspace text edit with revisioned writeback; device execution is unverified, and it cannot execute scripts, call child agents, bridge tool bindings or contain descendants. Package, startup and plugin-management checks reject activation.

The original workflow tool is intentionally unavailable until its PTC process and descendant confinement are implemented on Android; enabling it under App UID would not preserve workspace-write isolation.
Original persistence uses Android publication adaptation and no compression; full lifecycle parity requires acceptance beyond source presence.

sourceDigestPolicy: SHA256 of the corresponding inert YAML row encoded as sorted object keys, preserved array order and typed scalar values. Comments and YAML key order do not affect the digest; config, disabled expressions and nested declarations do.
